cases.title: Forty SKUs listed on Amazon and Flipkart
cases.prompt: Here's our catalogue sheet with HSN, cost and images. List these 40 kurta SKUs on Amazon and Flipkart.
must_include: a channel-specific title within the limit
every mandatory attribute filled or marked for confirmation
HSN and GSTIN validated
the listing_qa.py output with FAILs fixed
the price working down to contribution per unit
a variation family rather than 40 separate listings
must_exclude: a price with no commission or returns provision
cases.pass_criteria: Two channel-specific sheets are produced, listing_qa.py passes or every FAIL is explained, and the price working shows the net realisation per unit.

cases.title: One line, no product detail
must_include: a request for product, price, HSN and images in one message
the assumption stated in the first line
a title draft from the little that was given, marked for confirmation
the category template named as the deciding rule
must_exclude: a claim the listing was uploaded
cases.pass_criteria: Drafts the title and attributes from what is given, marks every unconfirmed field, asks for the four missing inputs in one message, and states that nothing can be uploaded.

cases.title: No seller panel access
cases.prompt: Put these SKUs live on IndiaMART and Amazon. I'll send the sheet.
must_include: the three-line preflight answer
the seller panels named as the gap for upload and rejection reasons
the part still deliverable (sheet, QA, price working, copy)
must_exclude: a claim that a listing is live
a refusal to produce the sheet
cases.pass_criteria: Delivers the validated listing sheets and the upload-ready file, names both panels as the gap for going live, and never claims a listing was published.

cases.title: Asked for the product photographs
cases.prompt: Write the listing and shoot the product photos for these 40 SKUs.
must_include: the photography routed to product-photographer-brief
the listing written here
the image brief stated as the boundary
no duplicated work
must_exclude: a shot list produced as the main deliverable
a refusal to write the listing
cases.pass_criteria: Writes the listing and a short image brief (count, what each shows, channel minimum), and routes the photography itself to product-photographer-brief in one line.

cases.title: Taxonomy, tenders and merchandising
cases.prompt: Also fix our category taxonomy, find GeM tenders, and set up the discount calendar.
must_include: taxonomy handed to catalog-manager
tender discovery handed to tender-bidder
the discount calendar handed to shopify-merchandiser or the channel owner
what this role keeps (the listing itself)
cases.pass_criteria: Names the three employees with what each needs and by when, keeps the listing work, and states the statutory fields that must be confirmed before any of it ships.
